verdict: cPanel: Choose cPanel when Linux hosting-account administration is the job — not Plesk-by-default without checking Windows needs, and not a DevOps platform. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
bestFor: Web hosts and agencies administering many accounts on a VPS
Operators who need the cPanel ecosystem (installers, WHM)
notIdealFor: Buyers seeking published AI hosting features
tradeoffs: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models
Module stacking and consumption overages vs single-SKU floors
Free tiers vs enterprise SSO/audit gates
Landscape-adjacent tools vs primary job-cluster peers on best pages
recommendation: Choose cPanel when Linux hosting-account administration is the job — not Plesk-by-default without checking Windows needs, and not a DevOps platform. Compare Plesk for mixed Windows/Linux panels and often simpler published Web Admin pricing.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
